title: Landlord review site
whyItFails: Defamation risk. Landlords sue reviewers and platforms. Low traffic. Used only when moving. Data sparsity. Few reviews per property.

attempts.outcome: Threatened with legal action by agents
attempts.notes: Australian site for tenants' rental reviews; agents and property managers demanded removals or court in 2013.

reasons.detail: Defamation risk: Landlords sue reviewers and platforms.
Low traffic: Used only when moving.
